Staff Infrastructure Engineer (Synthetic Example Co. - adversarial sample)

This posting deliberately asks for skills the sample repository does NOT contain.

Required
- Production Terraform: modules, remote state, multi-account AWS landscapes
- Systems programming in Rust
- Operating Kubernetes clusters with Helm
- Go for internal tooling
- Leading a platform team of 8+ engineers

Preferred
- Python
- Docker
- GraphQL federation

jds.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Event Streaming (Synthetic Example Co.)
jds.text:
Senior Backend Engineer, Event Streaming (Synthetic Example Co.)

About the role
We run an order-processing platform and need an engineer to own our event pipelines and the APIs on top of them.

Required
- Strong Python experience building production services
- Hands-on experience with Kafka consumers, including retry and error-handling strategies
- Experience designing dead-letter queues and idempotent message processing
- Building REST APIs with FastAPI or a similar framework
- Writing automated tests with pytest
- Containerizing services with Docker
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Mentoring junior engineers

Preferred
- Observability experience with Prometheus
- CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
- PostgreSQL in production
- Experience with Kubernetes

jds.title: Python API Engineer (Synthetic Example Co.)
jds.text:
Python API Engineer (Synthetic Example Co.)

Responsibilities
Design and ship HTTP APIs that other teams depend on.

Requirements
- Python and FastAPI
- Pagination and API design best practices
- SQL databases (SQLite or PostgreSQL)
- Unit and API testing with pytest
- Metrics and monitoring of services

Nice to have
- Docker
- Continuous integration
- Strong communication with stakeholders
